heroHeadline: Board of Peace Petitions UNSC to Press Hamas to Disarm; Lebanon Continues Direct-Talks Gamble Under Fire; Colombia 10 Days to Peace-or-War Election
heroSubtitle: May 21, 2026 — On May 20, the Board of Peace (chaired by former UN envoy Nickolay Mladenov) formally petitioned the UN Security Council to press Hamas to accept verified disarmament, naming Hamas's categorical refusal as the 'principal obstacle' to Gaza's Phase 2 ceasefire — the most direct UNSC advocacy move by the US-backed mechanism since the ceasefire began; the Council is scheduled to brief on the Middle East on May 22. In southern Lebanon, four IDF soldiers were wounded by a drone strike on May 20 (day 4 of the 45-day extension), and UPI assessed Lebanon as 'continuing its gamble' in the Washington direct-talks format; the Pentagon security track is six days away (May 29). Colombia's presidential election is 10 days away: latest AtlasIntel polling shows Cepeda at 37.4% vs. De la Espriella at 29.4% vs. Valencia at 20.9% — no candidate on course for a first-round majority, making a June 21 runoff increasingly likely; the outcome will determine whether Colombia's peace architecture advances (Cepeda) or is dismantled (De la Espriella). Russia-Ukraine: no new peace round announced as the war continues on the 1,000-km front despite Moscow's earlier signals of openness to resuming Istanbul talks. Iran's nuclear deadlock persists with the EU3 Istanbul track as Tehran's only active diplomatic channel and the Hormuz blockade entering week 12.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN, African Union, IGAD, Crisis Group, USIP, PA-X Database, and Tier 1–3 sources across all media poles.
